name: mailvex/mailvex-php
description: Official PHP & Laravel SDK for Mailvex Email Infrastructure. Supports single & batch emails, attachments, and webhook verification.

suggest.illuminate/support: Required to use Laravel ServiceProvider and Facades (^9.0|^10.0|^11.0)
suggest.illuminate/mail: Required to register the Mailvex Laravel Mail Transport (^9.0|^10.0|^11.0)
suggest.symfony/mailer: Required for the Symfony/Laravel mail transport adapter (^6.0|^7.0)
suggest.symfony/mime: Required for parsing MIME email messages (^6.0|^7.0)
